lines.text: Stage lights on. My mind's empty!
I blanked out in the middle of my speech.

data.define: To suddenly forget what you wanted to say or know.

example.text: I blanked out in the middle of my speech.

misuse.text: Don't say 'blank out' about a paper.

data.l1_hook: 무대 조명이 켜졌다. 내 머릿속이 텅 비었다! "blank out"
